searchText: Teku's networking has mostly been updated to v0.11.1 standard (few loose ends to deal with but enough to pull blocks). It worked with both the Topaz and Schlesi testnet. 🎉 Sadly on both testnets it considered block 64 invalid. 😦 I smell an epoch processing bug (apparently not exactly the same as the one Prysm had). Oh no 😦 , do you have an idea of what the bug is ? Interestingly though, when trying to run the transition with zcli for Schlesi it fails with "panic: empty committee" reading in even the original genesis state. lcli and teku both are fine with the genesis and lcli proceses the block that teku rejects fine. Beyond that, I'm just starting to dig into what the difference might be. I think zcli does some pre-state verification, which is why it fails. As far as i know the other clients don't do that do you have the block + pre-state for where it fails ? i could help debug on prysm's side I do, let me find somewhere to make it available. https://github.com/ajsutton/eth2-states/tree/master/schlesi-64-invalid has Teku's pre state and the block we were trying to update (pre state should have matched what everyone else had) great, thanks if you could put teku's post-state it would be helpful. I could diff it too We don't yet capture the state when we reject the block, but I'm about to change that. no prob, sounds good <@!476250636548308992> Just to confirm, was the epoch processing different between Prysm and Lighthouse at the first or second epoch? ie did lighthouse reject block 32 or 64? It rejected it in the second epoch 64 🙂 Good old 64 Psa! If you have a consensus bug, this almost certainly means a hole in our testing!! Plz report to spec repo when you find it :) Good, I had the first epoch in mind and was worried we had two bugs. 🙂 Slot 64 is brutal. 64 is where all the good stuff happens lol Can help by getting a post state too, but sounds like <@476250636548308992> has you covered Thanks. I suspect lcli's output is the state I should have. So once I finish brutally hacking in some post state capture I should be able to see the diff and go from there. https://github.com/ajsutton/eth2-states/tree/master/schlesi-64-invalid now has the resulting state from both teku and lcli. Looks like four validators have differing balances, which isn't overly surprising. Excellent, that confirms the block made no difference. Looks like we're awarding exactly half the reward we should have. Bingo found it. We're doing an `=` instead of a `+=` as part of `get_attestation_deltas`. Hard to spot in the java translation's verbosity. Without it, we can't connect to prysm nodes Otherwise, I think we should be able to sync from master with `--network=schlesi` We don't yet have snappy compression over gossip, so we won't get propagated blocks, but I think we should be able to sync historical blocks Yeah, when I test from ajsutton/skip-checking-genesis I'm pulling down blocks Yep Meredith is right. All my other changes I think had been merged but that one was waiting review. And I’m reasonably confident the reason we didn’t quite make it to head is the lack of gossip (because we aren’t doing snappy there yet). We basically didn’t know about hot blocks (also no ping rpc support yet). There is a —network schlesi Option now to make connecting easier. I’ve been using —eth1-enabled=false as well to save needing an eth1 node since I’m not yet running validators.
